initiatives.name: BeLoved Asheville
initiatives.description: A grassroots organization building community power through mutual aid, housing justice, and economic dignity. BeLoved works to create systemic change while providing direct support through their street medic team, community house, food distribution, and advocacy for unhoused neighbors.

initiatives.name: Pansy Collective
initiatives.description: A queer mutual aid collective in Asheville providing direct support, community care, and solidarity to LGBTQ+ community members through resource sharing, emergency assistance, and collective organizing.

initiatives.name: Tranzmission Prison Project
initiatives.description: Volunteer-run group in Asheville, NC that sends free books, zines, and resources to incarcerated LGBTQ+ people, mainly in the southeastern US.

initiatives.name: Firestorm Books
initiatives.description: Collectively owned radical bookstore and event space at 1022 Haywood Rd in Asheville. Run by a worker collective using consensus decision-making; open since 2008.

initiatives.name: The Steady Collective
initiatives.description: The Steady Collective distributes Naloxone, and provides syringe exchange services, wound care and a range of other services in three locations around Asheville.

initiatives.name: Blue Ridge Anarchist Black Cross
initiatives.description: We are prison abolitionists. We believe incarceration is not a solution to societal problems and support those challenging institutional oppression.

initiatives.name: Asheville DSA
initiatives.description: Western North Carolina chapter of the Democratic Socialists of America, based in Asheville. Holds monthly meetings and runs working groups on housing, electoral work, mutual aid, and community gardening.

initiatives.name: Asheville Survival Program
initiatives.description: Mutual aid network formed in 2020 that runs Streetside, a food, camping gear and supply distribution for unhoused people in Asheville, NC.

initiatives.name: 12 Baskets Cafe: a program of Asheville Poverty Initiative
initiatives.description: Cafe at 610 Haywood Rd in West Asheville serving free meals to anyone, run by Asheville Poverty Initiative. Also gives out grocery boxes and rescues food.
